fields.name: Type
fields.description: Job type: cr (change request) | bug (bug fix) | nf (new feature).

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Detailed description of what needs to change.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle: queued | planning | planned | approved | running | done | failed.

fields.name: RequestedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who submitted the request.

fields.name: PlannedModules
fields.description: JSON array of affected module IDs identified by the planner.

fields.name: PlannedAgents
fields.description: JSON array of agent IDs to run for this job.

fields.name: ArtifactsDir
fields.description: Path to the isolated planning artifacts directory.

fields.name: PlanSummary
fields.description: Human-readable summary of the planner's output.

fields.name: TicketIds
fields.description: Ticket ItemIds created from this planning job.

fields.name: ApprovedAt
fields.description: When the user approved the plan.

fields.name: ApprovedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who approved.

fields.name: CompletedAt
fields.description: When the full pipeline completed for this job.
